text: A shared vision of Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, the late Father Amir of Qatar, and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser led to the creation of Qatar Foundation; Sheikha Moza is Chairperson of Qatar Foundation.
short: Qatar Foundation's creation is credited to the late Father Amir and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, its chairperson

source.name: Qatar Foundation: About us
source.note: QF's own About page, 'Our Leadership' section.
source.quote: His Highness Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, the late Father Amir of Qatar, and Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser shared a vision for Qatar's future development, which led to the creation of Qatar Foundation.

additionalSources.name: Qatar Foundation: Qatar Foundation announces new CEO (Wayback Machine copy of 17 April 2026)
additionalSources.note: QF's own announcement naming Sheikha Moza bint Nasser as Chairperson of Qatar Foundation (photo caption on the page). The live page (https://www.qf.org.qa/stories/qatar-foundation-announces-new-ceo) returns 403 to scripts, so the archived copy is cited.
additionalSources.quote: Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, Chairperson of Qatar Foundation, with Her Excellency Sheikha Hind bint Hamad Al Thani and Yousif Al-Naama.
